events.title: Platform 2026: Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff — Exhibition
events.datetime: Tue 23 Jun – Sun 28 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: An annual exhibition funding three Queensland-emerging artists to create ambitious new projects. This year features new works by Dean Ansell (Melanesian mythologies), Spencer Harvie (online subcultures), and Seren Wagstaff (regional life artefacts).

events.title: Platform 2026: Artist Talks
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: Join the emerging artists of the Platform 2026 exhibition as they discuss their new works and creative processes. Seren Wagstaff, one of the featured artists, will speak about her installation and performance pieces.

events.title: Mandy Quadrio: Kukunna Wurraweena — Exhibition
events.datetime: Tue 23 Jun – Sun 28 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: Part of the Commissioners Circle Project 2026, this exhibition by Mandy Quadrio is presented at the IMA, a free public art gallery. Explore contemporary works by this featured artist.

events.title: Conrad Sewell — Bloodline Tour (with special guest Grace Sewell)
events.description: Conrad Sewell performs his Bloodline Tour live, joined by special guest Grace Sewell, at The Triffid. Expect a night of live contemporary music from the acclaimed Australian singer-songwriter.

events.title: The QUBE Effect Triffid Residency
events.description: The final Sunday of The QUBE Effect Triffid Residency, featuring an intimate performance from a local act. This recurring event highlights emerging Brisbane musicians.

events.title: Country Love: Gina Jeffreys & Rod McCormack, Brooke McClymont & Adam Eckersley, Mark & Jay O'SHEA
events.description: A special night featuring multiple acclaimed country music artists, including Gina Jeffreys & Rod McCormack, Brooke McClymont & Adam Eckersley, and Mark & Jay O'SHEA.

events.title: Live Music Event at The Triffid
events.description: An unnamed live music event is scheduled for Saturday night at The Triffid. Check the venue's official website for full artist and lineup details.

events.title: Cirque Nouvelle
events.description: Experience Cirque Nouvelle, a spectacular circus-inspired live performance blending music, acrobatics, and visual artistry at the Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Luude
events.description: Prominent Australian electronic/drum & bass artist Luude performs a high-energy live show at the Fortitude Music Hall. Expect a vibrant atmosphere with dance-focused electronic music.

events.title: Black Bear Lodge — Free Live Music
events.datetime: Fri 26 Jun & Sat 27 Jun, From evening
events.description: Catch free live music performances on Friday and Saturday evenings at Black Bear Lodge. This stylish candlelit hideaway offers an intimate setting for emerging and local artists on two stages.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition at GOMA
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Immerse yourself in Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson's expansive, multi-sensory exhibition that engages visitors' sense of perception through light, space, and natural phenomena.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
events.description: The eight-time Tony Award-nominated musical based on Tim Burton's film, following Lydia Deetz's encounter with a degenerate demon. A laugh-out-loud classic with Broadway star Andy Karl.

events.title: Delvene Cockatoo-Collins: Warrajamba Artist in Residence
events.description: Quandamooka artist Delvene Cockatoo-Collins leads a hands-on creative activation exploring the ancestral story of Warrajamba, the mermaid. Participants can create their own mermaid or dugong using artist-designed stamps, connecting with Indigenous culture and stories.

events.title: Fiona's Open Book Club — Avid Reader Bookshop
events.datetime: First Wednesday of the month (check for June session)
events.description: A community-oriented book club hosted by the independent Avid Reader bookshop, offering discussions on a diverse range of titles. Known for attracting thoughtful readers and fostering conversation.

events.title: The Philosophy Café Meet Up — Brisbane
events.description: An informal, non-technical group encouraging philosophical debate and active exchange of ideas. Ideal for curious individuals seeking intellectually stimulating discussions in a relaxed environment.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks — Dining Philosophers
events.datetime: Check Meetup for June date, 6:30 PM
events.location: Punjabi Palace Indian Restaurant, South Brisbane
events.description: Part of the Brisbane Social Geeks group, Dining Philosophers combines international cuisine with intellectual conversation. Expect discussions covering a range of topics among curious and engaged people.
